text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Circle area is proportional to capacity C in 2025/26 (MW, 99th percentile of AC output). Orange ring: Kirton, where the test found a demand that rises on cloudy days, so no capacity is estimated. Wrangle T1 and Wrangle T2 are two transformers at one site. Wrangle T1 is not sized, because its power is too small and noisy for the test.'
